answer: Cross-cluster quorum admission requires a newcomer to collect one signed sable from three disjoint ocean branches that share no transaction history with the recruit or each other. Each ocean tracks the funding ancestry of every candidate it vouches for and requires locking $20m$ onyx to issue the $m$-th concurrent sable to identities tracing back to the same root wallet. An honest entrant locks 60 onyx across three ocean branches for its three sable signatures, while one operator registering $k$ sybils must lock $30k(k+1)$ onyx or bribe $3k$ unrelated treasuries.
